name: Reserpine
summary: Reserpine is a drug that is used for the treatment of high blood pressure, usually in combination with a thiazide diuretic or vasodilator. Large clinical trials have shown that combined treatment with reserpine plus a thiazide diuretic reduces mortality of people with hypertension.

pharmacology.text: Reserpine irreversibly blocks the H+-coupled vesicular monoamine transporters, VMAT1 and VMAT2. VMAT1 is mostly expressed in neuroendocrine cells. VMAT2 is mostly expressed in neurons. Thus, it is the blockade of neuronal VMAT2 by reserpine that inhibits uptake and reduces stores of the monoamine neurotransmitters norepinephrine, dopamine, serotonin and histamine in the synaptic vesicles of neurons.

uses.text: Reserpine is a drug that is used for the treatment of high blood pressure, usually in combination with a thiazide diuretic or vasodilator. Large clinical trials have shown that combined treatment with reserpine plus a thiazide diuretic reduces mortality of people with hypertension. Reserpine has also been used for relief of psychotic symptoms.

summaryZh: 利血平（英語：Reserpine），或作利舍平，蛇根鹼，是一種用於治療高血壓及精神病的吲哚類生物鹼藥物，最初是在蘿芙木屬植物蛇根木中提煉而成。如今由於副作用較多並且更優的新藥上市，利血平已不再是治療的首選藥物。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include a stuffy nose, drowsiness, slow heart rate, dizziness on standing and stomach upset. It can cause serious depression, and its effects last a long time because it damages the transporters it binds.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括鼻塞、嗜睡、心跳變慢、起身頭暈和腸胃不適。它可能引起嚴重憂鬱，而且由於它會破壞所結合的轉運蛋白，作用會持續很久。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括鼻塞、嗜睡、心跳变慢、起身头晕和肠胃不适。它可能引起严重忧郁，而且由于它会破坏所结合的转运蛋白，作用会持续很久。

fact.en: Reserpine was isolated in 1952 from Rauwolfia serpentina, a root used in India for centuries. When patients on it became depressed, that observation helped build the idea that low monoamines cause depression.
fact.zh: 利血平於 1952 年從印度蛇根木中分離出來，這種根在印度已使用數百年。當服用它的病人出現憂鬱時，這個觀察促成了「單胺不足導致憂鬱」的理論。
fact.zhHans: 利血平于 1952 年从印度蛇根木中分离出来，这种根在印度已使用数百年。当服用它的病人出现忧郁时，这个观察促成了「单胺不足导致忧郁」的理论。
